violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED FOCACCIA BREAD WITH COOKED ONIONS ON TOP LEFT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE WITH THE OTHER COTTAGE (BAKED) GOODS. ROOM TEMPERATURE WAS ~70F (5HR). PIC STATED THEY THROW BAKED GOODS OUT AT THE END OF EACH DAY.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOCACCIA BREAD DISPOSED OF. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON BAKED VEGETABLES BEING TCS FOODS. PIC STATED THEY WILL MOVE FORWARD WITH 4HR TPHC WITH TCS BAKED GOODS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED A FULL SANITIZER BUCKET AND A CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLE STORED ON A SHELF WITH TO GO BOXES.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CHEMICALS RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON SEPARATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Thermometers Calibrated per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HOT WATER SANITIZING DISHPLATE TO BE 8F (152F) LOWER THAN CALIBRATED DISHPLATE OF THE EHS (160F)
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air temperature devices shall be maintained in good repair and be accurate within the intended range of use. HAVE THE DISHPLATE RECALIBRATED PER MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. ENSURE THIS IS ALWAYS CALIBRATED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Chemical rep arrived later during inspection, did not have heat sensitive test kit available. Will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: observed a thermometer in the 1 door prep top cooler located at the rear of cooler next to the air compressor fan
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. Person in charge moved 1 door prep top cooler thermometer to the warmest part of the cooler

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food was being received and stored on the floor of the kitchen next to the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge moved food off the floor to being stored on the dunnage racks TATTE BAKERY & CAFE (Inspection Date: 09/03/2025) Page 2 of 3
